# NetworkServicesAuthzExtension

`networkservices.gcp.hfl.dev/v1beta1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_network_services_authz_extension`. An authorization extension: a callout a load balancer or an agent gateway makes to a backend service or a Google service (iap.googleapis.com, Model Armor) before it allows a request.
